problem: Delivery friction remained higher than necessary because invalid metadata, orphaned tests, scheduler cancellations, stale state and moving-main overlap were sometimes discovered only after expensive CI or after the plan had already become stale.
root_causes: PR metadata generation was not always validated against the canonical admission parser before CI.
A test added by another main change was not wired into any workflow before it reached main, making current main preflight-red.
GitHub scheduler/concurrency cancellations can look like delivery failures unless distinguished from concrete failing assertions.
Shared hot surfaces such as continuity skills and delivery workflows increase collision probability between otherwise independent agents.
Agents could reason from a previously valid head/base/mergeability snapshot after main or the PR changed.
The delivery plan was not always required to include the post-merge deploy, readback, outcome and learning-skill projection path before mutation started.

evidence.scheduler_recovery: cancelled BRAIN and CodeQL jobs were successfully retried on the same exact head without production-code changes
evidence.moving_main: same obligation required repeated same-lineage reconciliations while main advanced
evidence.self_check_defect: the self-optimization regression expected optimization_fingerprint while the projected skill initially exposed only fingerprint

prevention: PR_METADATA_PREFLIGHT_BEFORE_CI: validate the generated PR body with the canonical delivery parser and allowed-value policy before expensive workflows start.
TEST_WORKFLOW_COVERAGE_COCHANGE: every executable test must be referenced by at least one workflow/classifier in the same candidate before merge.
CONTRACT_ASSERTION_PREFLIGHT: verify implementation, machine schema and regression assertions agree before remote CI.
CANCELLED_IS_NOT_CODE_FAILURE: without a concrete failing assertion, a cancelled job is scheduler/concurrency recovery input and should be retried on the same exact head.
HOT_SURFACE_COLLISION_MINIMIZATION: avoid touching shared delivery/continuity surfaces when a narrower skill or learning projection can carry the knowledge.
ANTICIPATE_BEFORE_ACT: refresh current authoritative state and predict the next likely invalidation before every material write, reconcile, retry, merge or promote.
NO_CACHED_IRREVERSIBLE_ACTION: re-read main/head/mergeability/gates immediately before irreversible delivery actions.
REPLAN_ON_EPOCH_CHANGE: when main/head/gate state changes, re-plan from the new epoch instead of replaying a stale plan.
SINGLE_LINEAGE_FORECASTING: do not create duplicate PRs for ordinary drift; keep one obligation lineage and use bounded current-main reconstruction only when divergence makes that safer.
TERMINAL_PATH_PREFLIGHT: before mutation, prove there is a complete executable path through protected merge, deploy/readback, outcome and learning/skill writeback.
CALIBRATE_FAILURE_FORECAST: persist predicted failure modes versus observed outcomes, including misses and false positives, and use them to improve future planning.
MEASURE_DELIVERY_FRICTION: record rejection, orphan-test, cancellation, reconciliation, overlap, stale-state-prevention and terminal lead-time signals.

expected_effect.direction: reduce avoidable CI retries, stale-state actions, duplicate lineages and stale-head reconciliations while preserving branch protection
expected_effect.success_condition: future material delivery detects preventable failure modes before remote CI or irreversible actions and reaches terminal proof in fewer delivery epochs
